_comment: Tier-2 for skfem time_dependent#5, verified 2026-08-06 on skfem 12.0.1. Claim: explicit/near-explicit stepping on stiff problems needs dt < 2/lambda_max with lambda_max from M^-1 K, and for reaction-diffusion with Da > 100 the required dt is infeasible. Ran: u_t = Laplace u - Da u on a 12x12 MeshTri.init_tensor with ElementTriP1 (169 DOFs), lambda_max from scipy.linalg.eigh on the free block, explicit runs at 0.9x and 1.1x the bound over 400 steps, a backward-Euler run at the unstable dt, and Da = 100 / 1e4 / 1e5. Printed: the bound is SHARP -- 0.9x decays from 1.0115e+00 to 3.0044e-11 while 1.1x grows to 2.4388e+26, both silently; adding the reaction shifts lambda_max by EXACTLY Da (residual -2.7e-12 and 5.5e-12); backward Euler at the unstable dt decays monotonically. THE Da > 100 THRESHOLD IS NOT UNIVERSAL: on this mesh the diffusive lambda_max is already 3.5759e+03, so Da = 100 barely moves the bound and only Da of the same order as lambda_max(M^-1 K) actually dominates -- at Da = 1e5 the bound falls to 1.9310e-05, i.e. 51788 steps per unit time.
